title: Enforce password history
powershell_check: (net accounts | Select-String 'Length of password history maintained' | Out-String) -replace '[^0-9]',''

title: Password must meet complexity requirements
gp_path: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account Policies\Password Policy\Password must meet complexity requirements

title: Store passwords using reversible encryption
gp_path: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account Policies\Password Policy\Store passwords using reversible encryption

title: Allow Administrator account lockout
gp_path: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account Policies\Account Lockout Policies\Allow Administrator account lockout
